metadata.description: Claude Code plugins that design and build hard-to-model mechanical parts in SolidWorks.

plugins.name: sw-gyroid-lattice
plugins.description: Gyroid / TPMS lattices for SolidWorks: fill any body at a target wall or density, graded, with skin; watertight STL import.

plugins.name: sw-diamond-lattice
plugins.description: Schwarz Diamond (D) TPMS lattices for SolidWorks: fill any body at a target wall or density, graded, with skin; watertight STL import.

plugins.name: sw-primitive-lattice
plugins.description: Schwarz Primitive (P) TPMS lattices for SolidWorks: fill any body at a target wall or density, graded, with skin; watertight STL import.

plugins.name: sw-iwp-lattice
plugins.description: Schoen I-WP TPMS lattices for SolidWorks: fill any body at a target wall or density, graded, with skin; watertight STL import.

plugins.name: sw-planetary-gearbox
plugins.description: Planetary gearbox designer for SolidWorks: tooth-count search, involute profiles, interference check, phased assembly.

plugins.name: sw-cycloidal-drive
plugins.description: Cycloidal drive designer for SolidWorks: exact disk profile, undercut and pin-contact checks, bearings, full part set.

plugins.name: sw-harmonic-drive
plugins.description: Harmonic / strain wave drive designer for SolidWorks: flexspline, circular spline, wave generator, deformed-mesh check.

plugins.name: sw-mcmaster-parts
plugins.description: McMaster-Carr CAD for SolidWorks via the McMaster MCP: find hardware, pull SLDPRT/STEP, insert into the active assembly.
